title: Sudden Change: The Awakening of the Twin Destinies
next_chapter_hook: "Just as the afterglow of that power fluctuation had not yet dissipated, in the far distant void, a breath that had pressed down upon countless ages suddenly awakened—the ultimate chess player, Cang Yutian, had arrived."

text.content: "The moment that divine sense quietly retreated, a voice rang out beside Chen Ji's ear: 'Do you want to survive? Do you want to overturn this dead chess game? Follow me.' The voice was aged yet familiar—it was Mo Xiansheng, the remnant soul guardian. Chen Ji's heart tightened, while the surrounding Servant Disciples remained in a daze, as if that方才的窥探 never existed. He walked deliberately toward a remote corner, his fingertips growing cold—the Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently in his Mental Sea, as if sensing some kind of summoning."

"Turning into an empty alley, Chen Ji whispered: 'Mo Xiansheng, come out.' The remnant soul slowly emerged from the first page of the Tianji Record, weak yet carrying an unprecedented solemnity: 'There's no time to explain. The other half of destiny... has awakened.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Twin Destinies—he had seen this name in the obscure records of the Tianji Record Fragment, but never imagined it would be connected to himself. In the next instant, his chest felt as if gripped by an invisible hand, pain surging like tidal waters."

"'Mm—' Chen Ji grunted, supporting himself against the wall with one hand. Deep within his Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment flickered wildly, golden characters scattering like startled fish. An unfamiliar yet violent power was awakening from the depths of his bloodline, spreading along the meridians to every limb. That power bore the same aura as the Tianji Record, yet was entirely different—more primal, more chaotic, more... uncontrollable. Mo Xiansheng's voice urgently rang out: 'Stay calm! If you panic, this power will devour you!'",

Meanwhile, above the heavens, the nine layers of clouds suddenly changed color. Within the Xuanwu Sect Council Hall, the old Sect Master Ling Yuan, who was in seclusion, abruptly opened his eyes, his gaze penetrating layers of halls to直视 that surging destiny fluctuation in the distance. A cold, sinister smile slowly curved his lips: 'Interesting... the other half of destiny, can finally hold back no longer?' And beneath the extreme northern glaciers, deep within the Ancient Forbidden Land sealed for ten thousand years, an eye that had lain dormant for countless ages quietly opened, its pupil reflecting the trajectory of heavenly destiny."

dialogue.content: "'Chen Ji, listen to me!' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently: 'The power within you resonates with the Twin Destinies, and right now it's attempting to merge with you. If you forcibly suppress it, your meridians will be completely severed; if you let it be, you will be devoured by backlash. The only way to survive is—to guide it!' Chen Ji gritted his teeth, veins bulging on his forehead, cold sweat sliding down his neck. That power was like an awakened ancient fierce beast, tearing at his divine consciousness."

text.content: "The Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's Mental Sea suddenly erupted with blinding light, golden characters spinning madly to form a strange vortex. That awakened power seemed to find a release outlet, rushing wildly into the vortex. Immediately after, a blurry image flashed before Chen Ji's eyes—a figure resembling his appearance yet with entirely different temperament, standing amidst mountains of corpses and seas of blood, surrounded by collapsed heavens and shattered earth. 'This is... foresight?' Chen Ji's heart shook violently—this image was too real, definitely not an illusion."

"That blurry figure seemed to sense something, slowly turning its head. Two pairs of eyes gazed at each other across the river of time, and Chen Ji immediately felt a tremor from the depths of his soul—that was the call of bloodline, the resonance of destiny, and even more so... the crisis of kindred destruction. The image flashed and vanished, but Chen Ji had already seen the madness and despair in that figure's eyes. He instinctively realized: that person was the other half of the Twin Destinies. And at this moment, the other party had also sensed his existence."

"'Hehe... found you.' A cold divine sense crossed infinite void, stabbing directly into Chen Ji's Mental Sea. That voice bore some resemblance to Chen Ji's, yet was filled with madness and distortion: 'My other half... we were originally of the same source, now is the time to merge into one.' Mo Xiansheng bellowed: 'Don't respond to him! That is the negative personality of the Twin Destinies, once merged, you will completely lose yourself!' Chen Ji convulsed violently, that divine sense coiling around him like a poisonous snake, attempting to invade his core divine soul."

"Above the heavens, the wind and clouds changed color. It wasn't just Ling Yuan—all the top experts of the cultivation world sensed this destiny fluctuation. Deep within the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, Ye Qing, who was in seclusion, abruptly awoke, demonic path mists surging instinctively as she gazed toward the Tianqing Sect, murmuring: 'This aura... did something happen to him?' Meanwhile, within the Xuanwu Sect, Han Lie was sparring with fellow disciples when, sensing that power, a gleam of apprehension and excitement mingled in his eyes—thattrash, actually awakening some kind of terrifying power?"

"Chen Ji's Mental Sea fell into unprecedented chaos. The negative personality's divine sense was like a branding iron heated red, brutally seared onto his divine soul, bringing tearing agony. 'Give up resistance,' that voice echoed in the Mental Sea, 'we were originally one entity, separated for ten thousand years, each in pain. Now reunited, that is destiny's correct answer.' Chen Ji guarded his spiritual platform with clarity, gritting teeth and saying: 'My, Chen Ji's destiny, only I myself decide!' He urgently channeled the Tianji Record Fragment, golden light blazing intensely, forcibly blocking that erosion."

choice.prompt: "The twin powers of destiny collided wildly within his body, the negative personality's divine sense pressed closer. Chen Ji had to make a choice within three breaths—how should this uncontrolled power be dealt with?"

choices.description: "Use the Tianji Record Fragment's power to forcibly seal the awakened power, severing the connection with the negative personality. The cost is suffering backlash, possibly seriously injuring one's foundation."

text.content: "Chen Ji's eyes were blood-red, the Tianji Record Fragment erupting with unprecedented light, golden characters like chains coiling toward that uncontrolled power. 'Get out!' he growled, pouring all his divine consciousness into the Fragment. That awakened power let out a piercing shriek, being forcibly suppressed back into the depths of his bloodline. Meanwhile, the negative personality's divine sense was severed, the voice becoming distorted with fury: 'You will regret this... when it awakens next time, it will be your death!'"

"The price came immediately. Chen Ji spat out a mouthful of blood, his meridians sending waves of stabbing pain, as if countless fine needles were roaming within his body. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed weakly: 'Fortunately... you held on. But this power is merely sleeping for now; when it awakens again, it will only be more fierce. You must, before then, find a true solution.' Chen Ji wiped the blood from his lips, yet his gaze turned cold as frozen iron—recorded, this debt will eventually be settled."

choices.description: "Follow the flow of that power, guide it into the dantian qi sea, attempting to merge with one's own cultivation system. There is risk, but if successful, new abilities can be obtained."
choices.risk_hint: "The merging process is perilous, requires extreme focus"

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath and made a crazy decision—he would guide this power rather than resist it. He emptied his mind, letting that violent power surge through his meridians, while using the Tianji Record Fragment as a guide, leading this power drop by drop into his dantian. The process was agonizing, but Chen Ji gritted his teeth and endured. Gradually, that uncontrolled power began to calm, slowly merging with his original True Qi."

"'Success...' Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, golden light flashing through his pupils. He felt the brand new power within his body, lips curving into a smile—he had actually obtained the ability of destiny perception. Although just a prototype, he could already vaguely sense the destiny trajectories of those around him, even predicting others' next moves within extremely short distances. This was simply a simplified version of the Tianji Record! The negative personality's voice rang out again, carrying unwillingness: 'Interesting... we shall meet again.'"

choices.description: "Take the risk to establish a connection with the negative personality, attempting to understand the other party's purpose. May obtain crucial information, but also may be completely devoured."
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain the truth of the Twin Destinies"

text.content: "Chen Ji made a decision that shocked even Mo Xiansheng—he no longer resisted, but actively opened his divine consciousness. 'Since we share the same source,' he whispered, 'let us meet honestly.' That negative personality's divine sense clearly hesitated, then let out a burst of harsh laughter: 'Interesting... you are more daring than I imagined.' The two consciousnesses collided in the Mental Sea, and Chen Ji saw countless fragmented images—the self before being split, the tragic truth of ten thousand years ago, the shocking chess game arranged by the Eye of Heavenly Dao."

"It turned out that he and that negative personality were originally the same existence—the previous master of the Tianji Record. Ten thousand years ago, the Eye of Heavenly Dao, to prevent him from foreseeing the ultimate truth, split his soul in two. The positive half was sealed within the Tianji Record Fragment, becoming Chen Xuan's inheritance; the negative half was exiled to the void, becoming a soul abandoned by destiny. And now, the resonance between the Fragment and Chen Ji's bloodline finally allowed these two split halves to meet again. 'The Eye of Heavenly Dao...' Chen Ji carved this name into his mind, the coldness in his eyes growing denser."

"No matter what choice Chen Ji made, the power fluctuation that erupted at that moment was like a lighthouse in the darkness, drawing countless watching gazes. Deep within the Tianqing Sect, Su Qingyao, who was on routine patrol, abruptly stopped, sensing that familiar yet unfamiliar power, her heart jumping: 'Chen Ji?' She almost instinctively rushed toward that direction. Meanwhile, the manager of the Servants' Quarters also sensed the abnormality, summoning personnel to investigate."

"Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul urgently said: 'Go quickly! No matter what choice you made, this fluctuation will attract sect experts. In your current state, you cannot withstand any interrogation!' Chen Ji forced himself to stand, his mind racing. Suppression succeeded, body empty; guidance succeeded, ability still unstable; resonance succeeded, obtained crucial intelligence yet divine soul exhausted—no matter the situation, he was not suitable to expose himself at this moment. Sensing approaching auras, he gritted teeth and rushed toward a remote corner."

"However, just at this moment, deep within the heavens, an invisible giant eye quietly opened. That was not Ling Yuan's spying, not the divine senses of sect experts, but a gaze from a higher dimension—the Eye of Heavenly Dao. It had finally noticed what was happening here. A will overriding everything poured down like ice water, freezing Chen Ji rigid. Mo Xiansheng exclaimed: 'It's here! Quickly—' Before he finished, that will had already transformed into substantial pressure, pressing fiercely down on Chen Ji."

dialogue.content: "'Interesting little thing,' that will directly acted upon Chen Ji's divine soul, the voice devoid of any emotion: 'Ten thousand years, and my chess piece has begun showing signs of awakening again.' Chen Ji felt his Mental Sea searing with pain, as if some invisible giant hand was rifling through his memories. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice continued: 'However... this saves me considerable effort. The fragments of destiny are finally returning to the chessboard.' Chen Ji guarded his spiritual platform with clarity, yet his heart was churning like vast waves—so everything about him, from beginning to end, had been under the gaze of this eye."

text.content: "That pressure grew heavier and heavier, cracks appearing in Chen Ji's divine soul. Just as he was about to collapse, that newly merged power within his body suddenly erupted, forming a thin light barrier, forcibly blocking that invisible giant hand's erosion. The Eye of Heavenly Dao seemed somewhat surprised: 'Oh? Has actually already merged with the power of destiny? Interesting... it seems this generation's chess piece is more resilient than any before.' It did not continue pressing, that will slowly retreated, leaving only words that sent chills down Chen Ji's spine: 'Grow well, chess piece. I am very much looking forward to seeing which step you ultimately reach.'"

"Chen Ji collapsed to the ground, cold sweat soaking his clothes. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul was also shaken: 'It... it actually let you go.' Chen Ji gasped, yet his mind raced. The Eye of Heavenly Dao did not kill him, not out of mercy, but because he still had use value. This meant that in that ultimate chess game, this chess piece of his had not yet reached the time to be discarded. With this thought, Chen Ji反而calm下来, even curving his lips into a cold smile: 'Want to use me as a chess piece? Then let's see who ultimately devours whom.'"

"The urgent footsteps and shouts of the sect patrol were heard in the distance, obviously the patrol team had been alerted by the earlier commotion. Mo Xiansheng urged: 'Leave here first, find a safe place to recover.' Chen Ji nodded, struggling to stand. He cast one final glance at the sky, the coldness in his eyes enough to intimidate any enemy—today's humiliation, he had recorded it. The Eye of Heavenly Dao, Ling Yuan, Han Lie, and that so-called other half of destiny... these people, he would not let a single one off."

"Just as Chen Ji was about to disappear at the alley's end, a figure ghosted over. Su Qingyao! Her gaze swept across the devastated scene, catching the lingering scent of blood in the air, her brow creasing. 'Chen Ji?' she called experimentally, yet only saw the corner of a robe flash at the alley's turn. She did not pursue, but stood quietly where she was, a complex gleam flickering in her eyes. That power fluctuation just now... why did it remind her of that person? No, impossible, how could thattrash possibly..."

"Meanwhile, in the extremely distant void, a breath that had pressed down upon countless ages suddenly awakened. That aura was ancient and powerful, carrying the霸道 of complete disregard for everything, as if a giant slowly walking out from ancient slumber. A pair of deep eyes opened in the void, penetrating layers of realms, gazing directly toward where Chen Ji was. 'The Twin Destinies... have actually appeared again.' That voice was low and full of interest, 'Interesting. This generation's chess game is more spectacular than any previous generation.' The ultimate chess player—Cang Yutian—had finally made his entrance."

"Chen Ji did not know how many eyes were注视着他. At this moment, he only wanted to return to his hiding place as quickly as possible, to restore his exhausted power. The awakening of the Twin Destinies, the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, and the appearance of that mysterious chess player—this chess game was growing more and more complex. But Chen Ji's lips curved slightly, a sharpness flickering in his eyes completely incompatible with histrash persona. Complex is good, in chaotic times, only muddy waters allow one to catch fish. He wanted everyone to know—the taste of being used as a chess piece was unpleasant—he, Chen Ji, wanted to be the one who plays the game!"
